message.content: {"verdict": "revise", "score": 0.62, "reasons": ["The artifact largely satisfies sections 1–3 but misses explicit reproduction commands in section 4 and a standalone one-paragraph recommendation in section 5 as requested.", "The fastest-approach highlight is not clearly surfaced in the timing results (no explicit emphasis or note identifying the fastest implementation).", "Some details rely on references to fib_results.json and imply full content elsewhere; ensure the report itself contains the exact commands and a clear recommendation without requiring external files.", "The document appears truncated in the provided content and may not include all required sections in a finalized form."], "guidance": "To bring this report up to spec, add: (1) a new Section 4 titled 'Reproduce the real run' with exact, copy-paste shell commands, environment setup steps, and any caveats required to reproduce fib_results.json; include prerequisites (Python version, dependencies), how to activate venv, and the commands used to generate the results. (2) a new Section 5 titled 'Recommendation' containing a single well-formed paragraph recommending which implementation to use in typical scenarios (e.g., small-to-moderate n vs. very large n), with brief justification. (3) In Section 3, explicitly call out and visually mark the fastest approach (e.g., bold or a note like 'FASTEST' next to the fastest row) and ensure the table clearly shows which implementation was fastest for each benchmark. (4) Ensure the reproduction commands and the recommendation are self-contained in fib_report.md and do not rely on external files beyond fib_results.json for full details. (5) Validate that all sections are present and that the document ends cleanly (no truncation)."}
